spot.html_text: The LEO-II prover (Benzmüller et al. 2015) is the successor of LEO (Benzmüller & Kohlhase 1998b, which was hardwired with the OMEGA proof assistant (LEO stands for Logical Engine of OMEGA). The provers are based on the RUE-resolution calculi developed in Benzmüller 1999a,b. LEO was the first prover to implement calculus rules for extensionality to avoid cut-simulation effects.
